component.name: OpenAnime
component.summary: Unofficial Linux desktop client for OpenAnime

description.p: OpenAnime is a clean, performance-focused Linux client for watching your favorite series. It's built to be fast, using WebGPU and Vulkan for buttery smooth 4K playback.

ul.li: Silky Smooth: Hardware acceleration that actually works on Linux.
Immersive: A frameless UI that gets out of your way while you watch.
Native Feel: Optimized for minimal resources and maximum performance on any desktop.
Implemented "highPerformance" toggle for hybrid GPU/old PC systems.
Auto-generation of clean config.json if missing.
Refactored internal config loading for better performance.

description.p: Major update featuring Discord Rich Presence and improved window management.

ul.li: Integrated Discord Rich Presence with natural Turkish status parsing.
Implemented window state persistence (remembers size and position).
Optimized custom titlebar with auto-hiding and clickability fixes.
Added deep linking support for openanime:// URLs.
Fixed fullscreen exit issues during episode navigation.

description.p: Stable release for Flathub with managed offline dependencies and critical fixes for keyboard navigation.

ul.li: Fixed WebGPU/Vulkan compatibility for NVIDIA/Wayland users via XWayland.
Optimized npm cache paths for deterministic offline builds.
Implemented Escape key for back navigation.

description.p: Flatpak release candidate with complete offline dependency tree and consolidated manifest.
Improved 4K playback performance with native Wayland support and hardware-accelerated video scaling.
Critical interface and shortcut fixes. F11 key now correctly toggles fullscreen mode.
User experience improvements. Escape key now exits fullscreen instead of quitting the application.
Initial stable release features smooth 4K playback with WebGPU + Vulkan hardware acceleration and a frameless modern UI.
